title: Chet Chetter's Tales from the Morgue
identity_notes: Modern old-radio-style audio theater created by Mark Sawyer and Jay Reel, not a Golden Age series. Nineteen frozen tracks belong to Tales From The Morgue (1989-1992 source-tag years); two later frozen tracks are tagged M & J Presents (1993-1994) and are retained as collection spillover rather than rewritten as original-series episodes. Creator history documents 19 Tales productions, 13 NPR broadcasts/commissions and six NPR rejections.

eras.label: Tales from the Morgue production period
eras.notes: M&J Audio Theater productions represented by 19 source-tagged frozen tracks.

eras.label: NPR Playhouse broadcast/commission period
eras.notes: Creator history documents four accepted/broadcast stories in 1990 and nine more ordered for a 13-show NPR series in 1992; exact episode air dates are not forced.

eras.label: M&J Presents collection spillover
eras.notes: Two frozen tracks are source-tagged M & J Presents rather than Tales From The Morgue and are classified as supplemental spillover.

historical_context.title: Modern old-time-radio revival production
historical_context.description: M&J Audio Theater consciously drew on X Minus One, Lum and Abner, Gunsmoke and Inner Sanctum-style radio traditions while producing a modern series.

historical_context.title: The Highway of Death launches the Chet Chetter project
historical_context.description: Mark Sawyer and Jay Reel produced The Highway of Death in 1989 as the first Chet Chetter story.

historical_context.title: Initial NPR Playhouse acceptance and broadcast
historical_context.description: NPR accepted the first story and ordered three more; four accepted stories were broadcast on NPR Playhouse in 1990.

historical_context.title: Thirteen-show NPR series
historical_context.description: NPR ordered nine more installments the following year for a complete 13-show series; one affiliate log begins June 7, 1992 and notes dates varied by station.

historical_context.title: M&J Presents expansion beyond Tales From The Morgue
historical_context.description: Frozen collection includes two later tracks whose embedded album tags identify M & J Presents rather than Tales From The Morgue.
